title: White Day Lost Class Funds
description:
This is a role-playing game. You will become a student male host to help your framed girlfriend and experience a day of puzzle solving, exploration and magic.

Synopsis: You will play the man who bought the gift the day before in white day and gave it to his girlfriend who lived with him, but things didn't go so smoothly. Your girlfriend was not at home that day, and you learned from your brother that your girlfriend was framed. In this game, you need to find clues, know his girlfriend's movements and why someone wants to frame your girlfriend.

Game features

Multiple endings: The game has three endings, and your extra discovery may lead to different endings.

Brain burning puzzle: an incredible circular staircase, looking for keys with strange tricks

Stimulate tension: 123 Woodenhead, chase after battle, crack the secret code and race against time at the same time
